messages:
maria-marketing: Quick coordination for tomorrow's release post — need the final changelog URL, canonical docs link, and a one-line benchmark we can use in the hero. also confirm canary timing: APAC first then global after 2h?

sam-eng: Yep. Changelog: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-04-02-changelog (ready). Canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-04-optimize. Canary plan: start 11:00 PDT in APAC, promote global at 13:00 PDT if SLOs hold.

maria-marketing: Can you paste the exact YAML for the playbook so support can cross-reference?

sam-eng: Paste below — use in playbook/blog: 
```
rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-04-02T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 15
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-04-02T13:00:00-07:00"
```

ellie-product: For hero: "95th pctl latency @256 tokens (A100, int8): 42ms — ~3.1x cost savings vs fp16." I can draft a short bench paragraph calling out batching and KV cache benefits.

maria-marketing: perfect. nate, want the webinar to align so we can demo the ramp? we were thinking ~90m after promote.

nate-growth: Scheduling webinar for 14:30 PDT. i'll set registration and embed code for the post; will share the iframe snippet here once ready.

maria-marketing: routing: enterprise leads must hit AE queue immediately. jon, is the support webhook ready to tag and route?

jon-sre: webhook in place. deploy-bot will POST to /support/lead-route when changelog is published. rule: tag "enterprise" when company_size > 200. example payload and sample CURL added to support playbook.

sam-eng: small heads-up: if marketing requests faster promotion (shorter than 2h) we need notice by 09:30 PDT so SRE can tweak autoscale thresholds.

maria-marketing: noted. we'll keep timeline. ellie, drop the blog intro + bench blurb here by 09:45? target publish at 10:00 PDT.

ellie-product: on it — posting draft in ~20m.

deploy-bot: scheduled publish hook set for 2026-04-02T10:00:00-07:00. If any asset changes after 09:30 PDT, ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: checklist: changelog link (sam) ✅ docs link (sam) ✅ benchmark blurb (ellie) ✅ webhook routing (jon) ✅ webinar embed + reg (nate) ✅ speakers (maria by EOD). i'll assemble final copy and post for quick review. :rocket:
